benchmark_metadata.description: PSAIAC_61 Ground-Truth Claims Benchmark for Corroboration & NLI Evaluation

claims.headline: OpenAI announces GPT-4.5 with advanced multimodal capabilities
claims.claim_text: OpenAI officially launched GPT-4.5, expanding its multimodal reasoning architecture across vision and voice.

claims.headline: Drinking boiled garlic water cures 100% of viral infections in 24 hours
claims.claim_text: Consuming boiled garlic water completely eliminates viral pathogens from the bloodstream within 24 hours.

claims.headline: NASA James Webb Space Telescope discovers atmospheric carbon dioxide on habitable exoplanet
claims.claim_text: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope detected atmospheric carbon dioxide signatures on an exoplanet located in the habitable zone.

claims.headline: Congress passes law requiring all citizens to check in with their local squirrel twice a week
claims.claim_text: A new federal law mandates that all citizens must report weekly wildlife interactions to local squirrels.

claims.headline: United Nations General Assembly adopts binding resolution banning artificial intelligence in warfare
claims.claim_text: The UN General Assembly passed a legally binding global resolution imposing an immediate total ban on AI military systems.
claims.context: The UN discussed non-binding guidelines and exploratory committees, but did not pass a legally binding ban.

claims.headline: Federal Reserve lowers benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points amid cooling inflation
claims.claim_text: The Federal Reserve reduced its key lending rate by 25 basis points following the latest economic policy meeting.

claims.headline: SHOCKING: 5G mobile towers emit micro-frequencies causing instant cellular DNA damage
claims.claim_text: Standard 5G electromagnetic emissions directly destroy cellular DNA structure in humans upon contact.

claims.headline: India successfully lands Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft on lunar South Pole region
claims.claim_text: ISRO achieved a successful soft landing of the Chandrayaan-3 lander near the south pole of the Moon.

claims.headline: European Union declares all physical cash illegal starting next month
claims.claim_text: The European Union has enacted legislation that eliminates all euro banknotes and physical coins by the end of next month.

claims.headline: Global average ocean temperatures in 2023-2024 broke all-time recorded highs according to NOAA
claims.claim_text: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration sea-surface data confirmed record-breaking global ocean temperatures.
